reviews.title: Fast and reliable upgrade for my HP ProBook 430 G6
reviews.comment:
I installed this Crucial 16GB DDR4 RAM in my HP ProBook 430 G6, and the performance improvement has been very noticeable. The laptop feels significantly faster and smoother now, especially when multitasking, opening multiple tabs, and switching between apps.
Installation was simple, and the memory was recognized immediately without any issues. It has been stable and reliable from the start, with no crashes or compatibility problems. For a laptop upgrade, this is exactly what I was looking for: straightforward, dependable, and effective.
If you want a clear boost in everyday performance, this is an excellent choice.
reviews.author: Alejandro

reviews.title: High-Speed 8GB DDR4 Laptop RAM Module
reviews.comment:
The Crucial 8GB DDR4 RAM is fast, reliable, and easy to install. It runs smoothly at 3200MHz and can be downclocked to 2933/2666MHz for compatibility with various laptops. Performance is excellent, and it provides a noticeable speed boost for multitasking and everyday computing.
Overall, this RAM module is high-quality, dependable, and a great value for upgrading laptops — highly recommended!

reviews.title: Perfect upgrade for Lenovo T490 laptop
reviews.comment: Perfect upgrade for Lenovo T490 laptop.  Came with 2 x 8GB where one is unfortunately hidden on the top side of the motherboard.  Did the easy upgrade and swapped the easier access slot with this 32GB resulting in 40GB of RAM.  Took a little longer to boot the first time as the laptop checked out the new RAM.  Subsequent reboots have been normal speed.  Ran the UEFI extended memory disagnostics perfectly.  The <Enter> then F10 option at boot is a really nice Lenovo feature.
reviews.author: Rick V
